answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 20644 Country: AU Title: Do we have to recite behind Imam in any namaz.Some says thats its Imams Duty and we dont have to recite at all.Please give detial about all Namaz as its different in Zuhar and Asr. Question: Maulvi sahab, Do we have to recite behind Imam in any namaz.Some says thats its Imams Duty and we dont have to recite at all.Please give detial about all Namaz as its different in Zuhar and Asr. Answer ID: 20644 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 478/331/L=1431) While offering salah behind an Imam though the salah is sirri or jahri (silent or loud) doing qirah (reciting from the Quran) is makrooh, yes muqtadi should recite takbeer, azkar, tashahhud etc along with Imam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
